data.gender_notes: Wilhelmus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Will or desire-helmer, helper of the people
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Germanic elements wil meaning "will" or "desire" and helm meaning "helmer" or "helper". In Christian tradition, it is associated with Saint Willibrord, a seventh-century Anglo-Saxon monk who became a missionary in Frisia. The name Wilhelmus carries the meaning “Will or desire-helmer, helper of the people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Wilhelmus usually hope their child will grow to embody will or desire-helmer, helper of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, determination, and helping others.

in_hebrew.name: וילהלמוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: וילהלמוס הוא שם שמקורו בשם הגרמני 'וילהלם', שמורכב מהמילים 'ויל' ו'הלם', שפירושם 'רצון' ו'קסדה' או 'מגן'. השם נגזר מהשפה הגרמנית ומשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא הרצון החזק שלי' או 'אלוהים הוא הקסדה שלי'. השם וילהלמוס משמש כגרסה לטינית של השם וילהלם ומשמש לעתים קרובות במסורת הנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Βίλελμος
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι το ισχυρό μου θέλημα
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Βίλελμος είναι η ελληνική μορφή του ονόματος 'Βίλελμ', το οποίο προέρχεται από τις γερμανικές λέξεις 'wil' και 'helm', που σημαίνει 'θέλημα' και 'κάππα' ή 'ασπίδα'. Το όνομα σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι το ισχυρό μου θέλημα' ή 'Ο Θεός είναι η ασπίδα μου'. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Βίλελμος έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί ως σύμβολο της πίστης και της δύναμης.

in_latin.name: Wilhelmus
in_latin.long_meaning: Wilhelmus est forma latina nominis 'Wilhelm', quod componitur ex verbis germanicis 'wil' et 'helm', quae significant 'voluntas' et 'cassis' seu 'scutum'. Nomen significat 'Deus est mea voluntas fortis' seu 'Deus est mea cassis'. In traditione christiana, nomen Wilhelmus adhibetur ut symbolum fidei et fortitudinis.

in_english.name: Wilhelmus
in_english.meaning: God is my strong will or desire
in_english.long_meaning: Wilhelmus is a Christian name derived from the Germanic name 'Wilhelm', composed of 'wil' meaning 'will' or 'desire' and 'helm' meaning 'helmet' or 'shield'. The name signifies 'God is my strong will' or 'God is my shield'. With roots in Germanic languages, Wilhelmus has been used in Christian tradition to symbolize faith, strength, and divine protection. Historically, the name has been borne by several saints and nobles, reflecting its significance in European Christian culture.

data.cultural_impact: The name Wilhelmus was popular during the Middle Ages in Europe, particularly in regions influenced by Germanic and Latin cultures. The combination of the Germanic and Latin elements in the name reflects the cultural fusion that was common during this time. The name's association with Saint Willibrord, a revered missionary and bishop, emphasizes the religious and spiritual influence of Christianity during this period.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Wilhelmus holds deep spiritual significance as it is derived from the Germanic elements wil meaning "will" or "desire" and helm meaning "helmer" or "helper". This name signifies the belief that one's will or desire, when aligned with God's will, can be a powerful force for good. Additionally, the association with Saint Willibrord, a renowned missionary and bishop, highlights the importance of faith, dedication, and helping others in the spiritual journey. This name encourages its bearer to seek courage, determination, and servant leadership in their spiritual life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Wilhelmus is derived from the Germanic elements "will" (desire, volition) and "helm" (protection, shelter). It signifies a strong-willed and protective leader, a fitting name for one who seeks to shield and guide others with unwavering determination. In a spiritual context, it represents the courage and resolve needed to defend and uphold Christian values and beliefs.
